correctness.rationale: Rank 0 and rank 2 idempotents give the two unique indicator terms. For rank 1, trace forces trace(A)=1, the 2x2 determinant identity reduces nilpotence to tr(AE)=1-det(A), and projection idempotents can be counted exactly by their image line. Noninvariant lines contribute one solution; invariant lines contribute q or zero. Substituting 1-det(A) into the trace-one characteristic polynomial gives det(A)^2, proving the stated correction. Exhaustive replay over F_2, F_3, F_4, F_5, and F_7 matches the formula and census for every matrix.

value.rationale: Nil-cleanness and unique nil-clean decompositions are established structural notions, and exact decomposition multiplicity is a natural finite-ring invariant. The theorem turns the qualitative 2x2 existence problem into a closed formula controlled by projective eigenlines, gives a complete finite-field census, and quantitatively isolates the F_2 whole-ring exception. This is more than a routine check or recomputation because it identifies the mechanism and all fibers uniformly in q.
